title: HistoricalPriceArchiveSchema
description: Schema for the persistent historical daily price archive. Stores 18+ months of dual nominal and split/dividend-adjusted daily closing prices and corporate action events per equity, enabling accurate market_price_at_announcement lookups for press release reconciliation (nominal) and true return calculations (adjusted).

symbol.description: Ticker symbol of the public equity.

daily_nominal_closes.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD date strings to nominal unadjusted closing prices in USD (matches historical news and SEC Form 4).

^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.description: Nominal closing price on this trading day in USD.

daily_split_adjusted_closes.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD date strings to split-adjusted closing prices in USD.

^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.description: Split-adjusted closing price on this trading day in USD.

daily_adjusted_closes.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD date strings to total-return adjusted closing prices in USD (backward-adjusted for splits and cash dividends).

^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.description: Total return adjusted closing price on this trading day in USD.

daily_closes.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD date strings to split-adjusted closing prices in USD (backward compatibility alias).

^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.description: Closing price on this trading day in USD.

splits.description: List of historical stock splits and reverse splits recorded for this equity.

dividends.description: List of historical cash dividends recorded for this equity.

first_date.description: Earliest date with a closing price in this archive entry.

last_date.description: Most recent date with a closing price in this archive entry.

total_trading_days.description: Total number of trading days stored in the archive entry.

as_of_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this archive entry was last updated.

provenance_source.description: Authoritative feed or API endpoint name.
